facts.fact: ESCCOM's investigation confirmed that Jenny Internet Eswatini had established and was using a direct cross-border fibre link into Eswatini at the Malutha Border Post, bypassing EPTC's backbone (the neighbouring country is not named); the Commission ordered Jenny to use EPTC backbone connectivity from 1 July 2026.
facts.system: Jenny Internet cross-border fibre link, Malutha Border Post

note: Backbone access order concerns the national backbone, not international capacity, so no access fact.
